entries.title: Judges 13:2
segments: Zorah; a city in the south part of the tribe of Dan.

entries.title: Judges 13:3
segments: The angel of the Lord; supposed to be the Angel-Jehovah, in the form of man, and the same who appeared to Moses, Joshua, and Gideon.
Our mercies and our trials are perfectly known to God, and he can so adapt his favors as in the best way and time to supply our wants.|

entries.title: Judges 13:4
segments: Children are the gift of God, and parents should take such a course as is best adapted to fit them for his service.

entries.title: Judges 13:5
segments: Nazarite; for the law of the Nazarite, which Manoah's wife was herself to observe till the birth of the child, see

entries.title: Judges 13:6
segments: Husbands and wives should avail themselves of each other's counsel, and thus unite their efforts, especially in every thing pertaining to the temporal and eternal welfare of their children.

entries.title: Judges 13:8
segments: One of the most important and difficult duties of parents is the right education of children; and no one will ever properly perform it, unless in the habit of daily seeking wisdom from God.

entries.title: Judges 13:9
segments: When parents ask direction from God how to treat their children, in order most to honor him, to benefit them, and, make them useful to others, God is ready to hear and to aid them in training their children in the way the should go.

entries.title: Judges 13:12
segments: How shall we order the child? or, what shall be the manner of the child?  The question relates to the mother's deportment before his birth, as immediately explained by the angel.

entries.title: Judges 13:13
segments: To be successful in the right education of children, parents must give heed to the directions of God on this subject; and if they would lead their children to obey him, they must be careful to set them the example.

entries.title: Judges 13:15
segments: The mercies of God bestowed on our children should increase our sense of obligation, and lead us to offer to him the sacrifices of praise and thanksgiving.

entries.title: Judges 13:18
segments: Secret; wonderful; the same in the original as in

. 
 
God manifest in the flesh is indeed, The Wonderful; and while we should receive with implicit confidence all that he reveals concerning himself, we should not seek to know what we cannot and do not need to understand.

entries.title: Judges 13:20
segments: The Lord is wonderful, not only in his nature and perfections, but in his operations; and they should inspire us not only with reverence and awe, but with admiration, confidence, and love.
